android.desc:
Stop organizing your life. Start executing it. 

Are you stuck in "Tutorial Hell"? Have a "Watch Later" playlist you haven't touched in months? Spend three hours planning a project or study schedule, only to abandon it on day three?

Standard to-do lists and daily planners are passive. They wait for you to do the work. Criene is an active AI Operating System designed to force execution, eliminate procrastination, and build unbreakable discipline.

Whether you are a self-taught developer, a student, or an entrepreneur, Criene bridges the "Execution Gap" between planning your goals and actually achieving them.

🚀 WHY CRIENE IS DIFFERENT
We don't just list your tasks; we gamify your consistency using Loss Aversion psychology. You don't manage Criene—Criene manages you.

🔥 CORE FEATURES

🤖 Ciara: Your AI System Architect & Roadmap Generator
Stop guessing what to execute today. Type your macro goal (e.g., "Learn MERN Stack" or "Launch a SaaS in 60 Days"), and Ciara will instantly generate a 30, 60, or 90-day execution roadmap. It decomposes massive ambitions into daily, bite-sized tasks.

❤️🔥 The 3-Lives System (Gamified Discipline)
Set your "Iron Rules" (e.g., "No social media before 12 PM" or "Code for 2 hours daily"). You get 3 Lives per month. Break an Iron Rule, and you lose a Life. Hit zero, and your streak resets. Real psychological stakes to stop you from quitting.

📊 Developer-Style Contribution Heatmap
Turn your chaotic days into a wall of green tiles. Every task completed, habit maintained, and rule followed feeds into your Personal Achievement Score (PAS), generating a GitHub-style contribution graph of your discipline.

⚡ Unplanned Wins & Initiative Bonus
Life doesn't fit on a rigid schedule. Did you fix a sudden bug or do extra study hours? Log "Unplanned Wins" to earn bonus PAS points for spontaneous hard work that wasn't on your original daily planner.

🧠 Neural Reflections & AI Journaling
End your day with a mandatory debugging log. Track your mental state, identify friction points, and use Ciara AI to polish your daily mindset entries into a permanent archive of your progress.

🔔 Smart Discipline Signals & Habit Loops
Set aggressive push notifications that keep you online. Get Mission Control alerts to start your day, Reflection prompts to end it, and persistent repeating loops for your daily habits.

📈 A COMPLETE LIFESTYLE & PRODUCTIVITY UPGRADE
True productivity isn’t about doing more; it’s about doing the rig
